approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: A cinematic vertical promotional teaser for an event called Lantern Night. At blue-hour nightfall, a beautiful garden walkway is filled with warm glowing golden paper lanterns hanging overhead, soft amber lights reflecting in a still pond, distant adult guests as soft silhouettes. One continuous smooth slow camera push forward beneath the lanterns toward the luminous garden. Elegant, magical, welcoming atmosphere, realistic photography, rich midnight blue and warm gold palette, beautiful soft bokeh, stable coherent lantern shapes. Centered elegant readable gold title text 'LANTERN NIGHT' with smaller white text beneath 'A night to glow'. No dates, no venue names, no logos, no extra text. Keep the title centered and within generous vertical social-media safe margins.
